Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
cure wrote:
> how do I request an errata on a card???

There is no submission/solicitation process for errata.

If you want errata, demonstrate the need for errata (by reason of
imbalance in the game or whatever other reasons can be cobbled
together to achieve the necessity of errata as a conclusion).

--

Messages.Author: hawk_the_demon
Messages.Body:
cu...@caramail.com (cure) wrote in message news:<64a19912.04021...@posting.google.com>...

> how do I request an errata on a card???

you just did, I believe.

> I would like to see the card "corruption" with at least the
> possibility to target vampire of my prey or predator, and may be
> another corruption card which cost more and can target any minion!

some reasoning on why that would be a good idea would not hurt.

I admit that this would make corruption decks more viable (not
completely screwed if the prey is playing with big vamps only) but I
don't think that this is enough to warrant an errata.

I think that a better approach would be to print cards in the future
that help building viable corruption decks. some ideas:

Master 1
Followers of Set
1 pool
Unique Master
Put this card in play.
You may tap this card when a minion successfully attempts a (D) action
against you to put a corruption counter on that minion. (burn clause)

Master 2
Followers of Set
Unique master
Put this card in play.
Minions with any of your corruption counters have -1 bleed when
bleeding you. (burn clause).

Reaction
Serpentis
1 blood
[ser] The action vampire gets +1 stealth, put a corruption counter on
the acting minion and tap this reacting vampire. The acting vampire
may cancel the efects of this card by burning one blood.
[SER] As [ser] but the acting minion cannot cancel this card.

Combat 1
Serpentis
[ser] Burn a corruption counter from the opposing minion to prevent
one damage.
[SER] Before range is chosen, burn a corruption counter from the
opposing minion to end combat.

just some rough ideas.

Messages.Author: Curevei
Messages.Body:


Corruption may be a really weak strategy, but there are a number of cards in
the game that, thankfully, only work against one's prey. Thankfully, because
minion screw against your predator is so much more powerful. Brainwash? In
general, just reduces pressure on your grandprey. If predator targetable,
every deck in existence should run copious amounts. Seeds of Corruption,
Gisela, etc. are similar.

Anyway, I'm happy Corruption is a weak strategy. Steal vampire effects don't
tend towards balance, especially permanent steal. If good enough to bother
with, then they tend to be huge swing effects in games when they happen.
